title: LLMs instead of Human Judges? A Large Scale Empirical Study across 20 NLP Evaluation Tasks
authors_zh: Anna Bavaresco、Raffaella Bernardi、Leonardo Bertolazzi、Desmond Elliott、Raquel Fern?ndez、Albert Gatt、Esam Ghaleb、Mario Giulianelli、Michael Hanna、Alexander Koller、Andre Martins、Philipp Mondorf、Vera Neplenbroek、Sandro Pezzelle、Barbara Plank、David Schlangen、Alessandro Suglia、Aditya K Surikuchi、Ece Takmaz、Alberto Testoni
best_for_zh: 需要细粒度事实性、安全性或评审反馈资源的研究者。
one_line: JUDGE-BENCH is the paper's released feedback or evaluation resource.
JUDGE-BENCH 汇聚 20 个带人类评分的数据集，覆盖事实性、推理、对话和生成质量，用于定位 LLM judge 与专家判断偏离的条件。
why: It makes a reusable feedback or evaluation surface available for auditing or training reasoning systems.
inclusion_reason: The release exposes fine-grained factuality, safety, or judgment feedback suitable for evaluation or post-training analysis.

title: Problem
问题
html:
LLM judges are increasingly used instead of humans, but high correlation on one task does not establish reliability for factuality, reasoning, dialogue, creative generation, and subjective quality. Agreement can depend on data type, annotator expertise, and whether text is human- or model-generated, while model updates reduce reproducibility.

The study aggregates twenty human-labelled NLP evaluation tasks, compares eleven LLM judges under common prompting, and analyses the conditions under which they approximate humans.

LLM Judge 被快速用于替代人工评分，但单个任务上的高相关性无法说明它在事实性、推理、对话、创意生成和主观质量上都可靠。不同数据类型、人类专家程度和文本来源会改变一致度，而模型版本更新又会削弱可复现性。

该研究汇聚 20 个带人类标签的 NLP 评测任务，以统一提示比较 11 个 LLM Judge，并分析哪些条件决定它们能否接近人类。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: JUDGE-BENCH harmonises twenty existing datasets with human ratings or labels into an LLM-as-a-judge meta-evaluation framework spanning tasks, evaluated properties, label types, and text sources. Eleven proprietary and open models are tested, and data conversion, prompts, and evaluation code are released. Its purpose is not a new judge model but selection, validation, and auditing of judges for specific tasks.
JUDGE-BENCH 将 20 个已有、带人工评分或标签的数据集统一成 LLM-as-a-Judge 元评测框架，覆盖多种任务、评价属性、标签类型和文本来源。作者评测 11 个专有与开放模型，公开数据转换、提示和评测代码。其核心用途不是训练某个新 Judge，而是选择、验证和审计 Judge 在具体任务上的适用性。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Aggregate human evaluations: Twenty NLP datasets with credible human labels are selected and harmonised into common sample, property, and label fields.
  1. Design common prompts: Comparable judge prompts are created for binary, ordinal, and continuous tasks with limited task-specific engineering.
  1. Run eleven judges: Proprietary and open LLMs assign labels or scores to the same texts, with models, settings, and outputs recorded.
  1. Analyse agreement factors: Agreement is analysed by task, property, annotator expertise, and human/model text source; judge versions and decoding must be fixed.

1. 汇聚人类评测集： 作者选择 20 个含可靠人工标签的 NLP 数据集，并统一样本、属性和标签字段。
  1. 设计统一提示： 根据二元、等级或连续评分任务构造可比较的 Judge 提示，尽量减少任务特有工程。
  1. 运行 11 个 Judge： 专有和开放 LLM 对同一文本给出标签或分数，作者记录模型、设置与输出。
  1. 分析一致性条件： 按任务、属性、专家程度和人类/模型文本来源计算一致度；复现需固定 Judge 版本和解码参数。

title: Evidence
证据
html: No LLM consistently matches humans across all twenty tasks, and the same model shows large agreement variation across datasets, evaluated properties, and label scales. Human annotator expertise and whether evaluated text is human- or model-generated also materially affect results. Therefore, a model cannot be called a strong judge independently of task; the evidence supports task-level human calibration rather than universal replacement.
大规模结果显示，没有任何 LLM 在 20 个任务上持续接近人类；同一模型在不同数据集、评价属性和标签尺度上的一致度差异很大。人类专业程度以及被评文本来自人还是模型，也会显著改变结果。因此“某模型是强 Judge”不能脱离任务成立，论文证据支持在使用前进行任务级人类校准，而不是普遍替代人工。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Earlier LLM-judge studies usually test one benchmark or quality property and generalise local high agreement too broadly. This study unifies twenty real human-evaluation datasets and eleven models and analyses task, label, human expertise, and text source. The novelty is breadth and conditional reliability analysis rather than a new scoring prompt.
既有 LLM Judge 论文通常在单一 benchmark 或一种质量属性上测试，并容易把局部高相关性推广为通用结论。该研究统一 20 个真实人评数据集和 11 个模型，系统分析任务、标签、人类专业度与文本来源。新意是覆盖广度和条件化可靠性分析，而不是新的评分提示。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Limitation 1: The twenty datasets remain a selected sample with limited domain, language, and high-stakes expertise coverage.
  1. Limitation 2: Human-label quality and disagreement differ across datasets, and common metrics do not remove all heterogeneity.
  1. Limitation 3: Proprietary judges change over time, so model dates and outputs must be preserved.

1. 局限1： 20 个数据集仍是已有资源的选择，领域、语言和高风险专业判断覆盖有限。
  1. 局限2： 不同数据集的人类标签质量与分歧结构不同，统一相关指标不能完全消除差异。
  1. 局限3： 专有 Judge 会更新，论文数值可能随 API 版本漂移；应保存模型日期和输出。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
1. Use case 1: Before adopting a judge, select the closest JUDGE-BENCH task and measure agreement and bias against humans.
  1. Use case 2: Compare candidate judges for stability in factuality, dialogue, or generation quality rather than one average rank.
  1. Use case 3: High-stakes decisions require task-specific human validation and cannot rely on agreement reported elsewhere.

1. 使用场景1： 在采用 LLM Judge 前，可从 JUDGE-BENCH 选择最接近的任务，测与人工标签的一致度和偏差。
  1. 使用场景2： 可比较候选 Judge 在事实性、对话或生成质量上的稳定性，而不是只看平均排名。
  1. 使用场景3： 高风险决策若没有任务级人类验证，不应以论文中其他任务的高相关性作为依据。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. Position: JUDGE-BENCH tests whether LLMs replace humans across twenty NLP evaluations.
  2. Method: Data harmonisation, task prompts, eleven judges, and conditional agreement analysis.
  3. Data: Twenty human-labelled datasets plus conversion, prompts, and evaluation code are released.
  4. Evidence: No model is consistently human-like; expertise and text source materially affect agreement.
  5. Reuse: Suitable for judge selection; calibrate every production task with humans first.

1. 一句话定位： JUDGE-BENCH 检验 LLM 是否能跨 20 类 NLP 人评任务替代人工。
  2. 方法抓手： 数据统一、任务化提示、11 个 Judge 和多条件一致性分析。
  3. 数据抓手： 20 个带人类标签的数据集及转换、提示、评测代码开放。
  4. 证据锚点： 没有模型跨任务稳定接近人类，专业度与文本来源显著影响结果。
  5. 复用决定： 适合 Judge 选型；任何生产任务都应先做人类校准。
